visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black-and-white line engraving depicting a desert scene with a group of people and camels. One person is mounted on a standing camel, another person is kneeling beside a resting camel, and a man in Western-style clothing stands nearby. The background features rugged, mountainous terrain.
